propositions: Four model-provenance guard tests repeatedly invoke _run_request_sites(), each re-deriving identical AST analysis of the src/rebar tree, causing redundant per-test computation.

Within each _run_request_sites() call, _verdict's parameter-provenance branch re-walks and re-parses the entire src/rebar file tree once per site with parameter-provenance config, causing ~8,033 parses per single scan despite fewer files in the tree.
The AST analysis is a pure function of committed src/rebar source; no test mutates the tree and the only autouse fixture patches unrelated code, making caching safe.
Caching _run_request_sites() at session scope and memoizing per-path ast.parse() calls removes both layers of repetition without changing assertion bodies, offender messages, or registry checks.
